notes.title: 1.0 Launch
notes.content:
[h2]Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin' is out now![/h2]

After just over 3 years in development, my first ever game has been released!
Thank you, everyone, for all your support along the way.
To celebrate the game's launch, it will be 25% off for a week. In addition, the game's soundtrack is now available to purchase!

If you have been enjoying my game so far, I would really appreciate it if you could spread the word about it - whether you leave a Steam review, tell your friends about it or make a video.

As for what's next, well, it really depends on how RTLS does. I'm prototyping some new game ideas that are really cool, but very different. If the game is more successful though, I would love to update it further, add more enemies and upgrades, or even make a sequel.

I hope you enjoy the game!

Thanks

William

[*][h3]Dartboard [/h3]You gain 25% damage for each attack without missing, up to 125% -> You gain 50% damage for each attack without missing, up to 250%

[/list]
[*] [h2]Changed Weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Shell [/h3]Now works with upgrades and doesn't make you bounce off whatever you hit
[*][h3]Shield [/h3]Block all damage for 2 turns -> Block all damage for 3 turns
[*][h3]Spurs [/h3]You can move 3 tiles without advancing time -> Stop time for 5 turns
[*][h3]Baseball Bat[/h3] Now works with upgrades
[*][h3]Lasso [/h3]Pull enemies up to 6 tiles away towards you and stun them for 4 turns -> Throw a lasso. It travels 4 tiles each turn and stops enemies from attacking or moving until attacked
[*][h3]Flail [/h3]Swing a spikeball around you for 2 turns. It deals 2 damage -> Swing a spikeball around you for 6 turns. It deals 2 damage and blocks bullets
[*][h3]Blowgun [/h3]Lasts 6 turns -> 8 turns,  Charmed enemies can now see enemies through walls and can walk
[/list]
[*] [h3]Removed Upgrade[/h3]Multiball
[*] [h3]Updated Sprites[/h3]
[list]
[*]Ectoplasm
[*]Fire Pepper
[/list]
[*] Upgrade inventory now displays counters for upgrades that use them
[*] Coyote now uses a Bowie Knife instead of a Revolver
[*] Melee weapons are now visibly longer or shorter depending on their range
[*] Combo timer now stops when you exit the level
[*] Combo timer now stops when time is stopped
[*] Replays menu is now split into pages, and no longer crashes from trying to create a massive image
[*] Fixed bullet repellent - now only repels enemy bullets that are in your line of sight
[*] Fixed charmed enemies not being able to attack each other on Pimento and higher difficulties
[*] Fixed sentries not working with upgrades

[*][h3]Shot Speed Plus[/h3] 25% faster bullets -> 30% faster bullets
[*][h3]Small Bullets[/h3] 50% faster bullets -> 60% faster bullets
[/list]

[list]
[*][h3]Ice Blast [/h3] Moves 2 tiles each turn -> 4 tiles each turn
[*][h3]Magic Missile [/h3] Increased spread
[*][h3]Whip [/h3] 2 charge -> 1 charge, 10 uses -> 15 uses
[*][h3]Bowie Knife [/h3] 6 uses -> 8 uses
[*][h3]Longsword[/h3] Hits in a much larger area
[*][h3]Sledgehammer [/h3] Direct hit can destroy blocks
[*][h3]Bubble Wand[/h3] 5 uses -> 3 uses
[*][h3]Shotgun [/h3] Reduced spread
[*][h3]Sawn-Off Shotgun[/h3] Reduced spread

[*] Improved held position of all items
[*] Necromancer is smarter and now shoots
[*] Swamp Hag no longer spawns a voodoo doll at half health
[*] Swamp Hag's homing shot now only travels 10 tiles
[*] Levels are more linear and have fewer side rooms
[*] All melee weapons hit in a larger area
[*] Adjusted various enemies' health
[*] Trying to use an item while hovering over Flint will now result in waiting instead
[*] Crates and pots are now spread more evenly throughout levels
[*] The number of enemies in each level increases more slowly
[*] Thrown items now stop when they hit a wall, instead of gliding along the wall
[*] Thrown items that have pierced an enemy can no longer be picked back up
[*] Power Pommel shots are bigger
[*] Item upgrades now have an upgrade symbol next to them
[*] Item collection stats are no longer increased by replay playback
[*] Fixed Blueprint turning into copied upgrade when moved
[*] Bandage price is now inversely proportional to how many hearts you have
[*] Replays now track your aim over time and can play it back
[*] Fixed Festive Potted Plant
[*] Fixed a desync
[*] Fixed Upgrade swap crash
[*] Hiding the HUD now also hides tooltips and replaces the in-game cursor with the hardware cursor
[*] Fixed Shell crash
[/list]
